items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 26 at 2:03PM EDT until September 27 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 20 kt and seas 4 to 6 feet.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
